method: Playwright (project chromium, 1440x900 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 1, pointer parked at 1430,5 and focus blurred before every capture) + PIL pixel measurement of design/award-system.png (1440x6410). Playwright MCP was unavailable (channel 'chrome' not installed; installing is out of scope), so capture ran through the project's own Playwright build.
comparisonMetric: No deterministic pixel-diff metric exists: the reference is a Figma frame export, not a rendered baseline. Geometry and colour findings below are measured numbers; everything else is a qualitative judgment.

awardBadgeImages.verdict: MISMATCH — material. Square source stretched to the height of the text column; signature-2025-creator is 2.88x vertical distortion.

cardIcons.shape: filled path, no stroke, 24x24 viewBox — matches the frame's filled diamond
cardIcons.verdict: MISMATCH — colour only. Shape/weight correct; fill should be white, matching the frame and the inactive menu icons.

kudosBlock.verdict: MISMATCH — material. Not just an inset: the narrower text column pushes the body copy under the KUDOS logo, which the frame keeps clear.

hoacSeparator.designFrame: confirmed — the frame renders the separator in the same near-invisible slate tone next to a hairline rule
hoacSeparator.verdict: holds up against the frame; flagged as an accessibility observation, not a design deviation

deepLinkTransient.verdict: end state correct; ~290ms flash of the wrong active item
